newsitem.title: CHAD: Gunmen kill two in south Chad.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill two in south Chad.

text.p: Unidentified gunmen killed an official and a civilian and seriously wounded two people in a raid on an administrative post in southern Chad, a military source said on Thursday.

The attackers looted a senior official's home in Boum-Kebbir near Lake Iro in the Moyen Chari region and burnt that of a dignitary, the source added. They also made off with a radio transmitter belonging to the national weather service.

The identity of the attackers and the day of the attack were not immediately clear. The attack was the first of its kind in the area, which is east of the southern Doba basin area where Chad has found oil.
Local units of Exxon, Shell and Elf Aquitaine SA are prospecting in the south and west.
The discovery of significant oil reserves in the Doba basin, due to come on stream in 2000, has raised the stakes in the traditional rivalry between Moslem north and mainly Christian south.
